log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file where HTTP traffic is recorded.

interface.description: Network interface to capture traffic on (e.g., 'eth0'). Leave empty to capture on all interfaces.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the HTTP proxy to (e.g., '127.0.0.1'). Leave empty to bind to all addresses.

port.description: TCP port the httpry proxy listens on. Use 0 for automatic port selection.

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose logging of internal operations and debugging.

packet_logging.description: If true, logs raw packet data (low-level network details) for deep inspection.

logging.description: If true, enables HTTP request/response header and content logging.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections the server accepts.

connection_timeout.description: Number of seconds to wait before timing out an idle connection.

ssl_decryption.description: If true, attempts SSL/TLS decryption using provided certificate/key files. Requires both ssl_key and ssl_cert.

ssl_key.description: Path to the private key file for SSL/TLS decryption (only required if ssl_decryption is enabled).

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file for decryption (only required if ssl_decryption is enabled).

exclude_hosts.description: List of hosts or CIDR subnets to exclude from logging (e.g., ['192.168.1.0/24', 'localhost']).

include_hosts.description: If non-empty, only log traffic to/from these hosts or subnets. Leave empty to log all traffic.

log_format.description: Output format for logs: 'standard' (human-readable), 'json' (machine-readable), or 'extended' (detailed headers).

reverse_dns.description: If true, performs reverse DNS lookups to convert IPs to hostnames in logs.

session_dir.description: Directory to store session state files for continuity across restarts.

max_session_file_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) of each session file before rotation. Use 0 for unlimited.

max_session_files.description: Number of rotated session files to keep. Use 0 to retain all.

session_expiration.description: If true, automatically remove sessions older than session_ttl.

session_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for inactive sessions before expiration.

daemon_user.description: System user to drop privileges to after starting (for security).

daemon_group.description: System group to drop privileges to after starting.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used for process management.
